lines.text: Hosting the Christmas party this year? Print one file, and the whole night is planned. Guests mingle with Find the Guest Who. Swap gifts with the white elephant dice game. Then crown the winners with twelve funny awards. Six games and sixteen pages, for family or office. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.
